| 5 | the client names it | 4 |
| 4 | EA source, or a structure-confirmed Net-7 / C# name | 28 |
| 3 | by convention from a client-named file or sibling | 272 |
| 2 | describes what the code does | 612 |
| 1 | neutral placeholder | 628 |
